part1.title: You're Paying for Subscriptions You Forgot #shorts
part1.description:
Copy 3 months of card payments (hide your card and account numbers), ask AI to list every repeating charge and its price per year, then cancel the ones you don't use yourself.
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.
